title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region residency and audit hardening
author: Aisha Malik
description: Context: Recent compliance reviews and a customer audit flagged two gaps: (1) KMS-backed secrets could be created without region residency checks and (2) audit logs did not consistently include encrypted_key_id and key_region fields needed for regulatory tracing. This PR implements RBAC v2 policy enforcement for KMS region residency, enriches audit logging, and hardens related validation paths. Summary of changes: - Add a new RBAC policy condition 'kms_region_residency' that allows org admins to require resources using KMS to be provisioned in a customer-approved region set. - Enforce the policy at create/update APIs for Secrets, Deployments, and PrivateInstaller manifests with a pluggable policy evaluation hook. - Enrich audit events with 'encrypted_key_id', 'key_region', and 'kms_policy_evaluation' result for all KMS operations. - Migration script: backfill existing secrets with last_encrypted_key_id and key_region where available; mark resources that violate residency in a migration report. - Add feature flag 'rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforce' (default: off) and a CLI toggle for Private deployments; when off, the change still emits audit events with 'kms_policy_evaluation' set to 'audit-only'. Motivation: Provide a clear enforcement path for customers subject to data residency requirements and produce deterministic audit trails for security teams and regulators. Checklist: - [x] RBAC policy schema extension and evaluator implemented - [x] API-level enforcement with graceful fallback when flag is off - [x] Audit log enrichment for KMS operations - [x] Migration/backfill and reporting tool - [x] Unit and integration tests added - [x] Documentation updates and release notes included Rolling this out: staged rollout using the feature flag; will enable audit-only mode org-wide for 48 hours, monitor, then flip to enforce for opt-in customers before broad rollout.
commits_summary: 3 commits: 1) rbac: add kms_region_residency condition and evaluator (schema + unit tests); 2) api: enforce policy in secrets/deployments + feature flag; 3) ops: add migration/backfill script, audit enrichment, docs and tests.

internal/rbac/v2/evaluator.go - add evaluation path and error codes
api/handlers/deployments.go - enforcement hook for deployment manifests

Ops: Canary scheduled in staging and one private customer cluster; no failures observed after 24h.
release_notes: Enforceable RBAC v2 policy for KMS region residency. Audit logs now include encrypted_key_id and key_region for KMS operations. Migration tool provided to backfill key region metadata and generate a residency violation report. Feature flag 'rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforce' controls rollout (default: audit-only).
security_impact: High: introduces an enforcement knob that can prevent resources from being created if KMS keys are out-of-region. Adds audit fields to help compliance teams trace encryption usage.
testing: Added 42 unit tests for policy evaluator and 6 integration tests covering create/update flows for Secrets and Deployments with mock KMS. Ran a 24h canary with Private Installer against staging and one customer cluster. Migration script tested on snapshot of production meta-store in staging; report generation validated.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge to main behind feature flag (audit-only). 2) Enable audit-only mode org-wide for 48h and monitor metrics: audit event volume, API error rates, and migration report counts. 3) Offer opt-in enforcement to early-adopter customers and run targeted canaries. 4) After 2 weeks of stable opt-ins, flip default to enforce and communicate via release notes and customer callouts.
notes_for_support: Support: customers that observe create failures will see error code RBAC_KMS_REGION_VIOLATION and can temporarily opt-out by requesting a migration-assisted remediation or using the Private CLI to set an allowed-key-region for the resource.
